synopsis: Epiroc Titan CAS and CAS Interface launched in 2021 for underground loaders and trucks, providing EMESRT Level 9 slow-and-stop intervention [f1667, f1668]. Titan uses multi-technology fusion, with detection of tagged people and machines using low frequency, time-of-flight, GPS and AI cameras; everyone and every machine must be tagged [f442, f678, f1669, f1670]. The corpus presents this fusion architecture as relevant to limiting what perception alone must prove [f442]. Epiroc offers evaluation without enforcing intervention, and its Titan page recommends evaluation before enforcing Level 9, despite claiming full Level 7, 8 and 9 capability; this contrasts with South African practice pushing Level 9 mandates [f1079, f6420, f6575]. Speed, direction and operating-condition information were not found for Titan CAS and CAS Interface, leaving important evidence gaps for planning validation [f1671].
